description: Independent semantic review of a catalog case's ground truth, kept apart from detector conformance: a COVERED row in the full example matrix only says some lane matched the recorded expectation, not that the expectation itself was proven. A case is listed here only when its expected verdict/kinds were checked against evidence that is not abicheck's own output (a compiler oracle, a source smoke, a runtime witness). Every case not listed is 'unreviewed'.

case64_calling_convention_changed.note: Old consumer computes the wrong dot product against v2 (registers differ); GCC and Clang agree the attribute differs.

case69_trivial_to_nontrivial.note: g++ __is_trivially_copyable flips true->false; checked with and without debug info.

case111_enumerable_thread_specific_lambd.note: ets({}) compiles against v1 and is ambiguous against v2; ets(42) resolves against both.

case186_c_api_pointee_const_abi_neutral.note: Direct calls compile against both; a void (*)(char *) callback rejects v2.

case207_pointer_parameter_gained_restric.note: Overlapping prefix-sum consumer changes result under GCC and Clang at -O3.

case208_restrict_added_to_definition_onl.note: Declared interface identical; behavioral break recorded with truth_scope declared-interface.

case209_calling_convention_changed_via_m.note: Old app prints dot 0.0 and exits 1 against v2; the macro expands to different attributes.

case210_calling_convention_respelled_via.note: Old app exits 0 against both libraries; same expansion.

case211_return_pointee_gained_const.note: char *p = get_name() compiles against v1 and is rejected against v2; old binary runs against both.

case212_calling_convention_macro_undefin.note: Old app exits 0 against v1 and 1 against v2; gcc accepts vector_dot as an ms_abi function pointer only with v2.h.

case213_calling_convention_function_like.note: Old app exits 0 against v1 and 1 against v2; the macro argument switches sysv_abi to ms_abi.

case214_calling_convention_macro_redefin.note: Old app exits 0 against both; vector_dot is ms_abi in both, the later redefinition does not reach it.

case215_return_double_pointer_lost_const.note: Old app exits 0 against both; const char **p = get_names(); is rejected against v2 by g++ and clang++.

case216_overload_added_beside_initialize.note: pick({}) returns 2 against v1 and, rebuilt, against v2 under g++ and clang++; no ambiguity.
